supported: Event data can be turned into leakage-free, opponent-adjusted tactical measures and team profiles.
not_supported: That any tactic CAUSES better results (observational data; no causal identification).

supported: Within one season, specific tactical profiles are associated with better or worse outcomes than expected.
not_supported: That the recommended plan is the best tactic or guarantees a win.

supported: A transparent, reproducible pipeline can produce a pre-match evidence summary, a simulated scenario comparison and a match plan.
not_supported: Direct man-marking effectiveness (marking is not observed; suppression is a proxy).

supported: The pre-registered backtest did not show that choosing tactics from historical associations improves outcomes.
not_supported: Tracking-based shape, compactness or defensive-line height (no tracking data).
Injury-proneness or fitness prediction (no medical or injury-history data).
Multi-source analysis (single source: StatsBomb Open Data).
Monte Carlo win probabilities as forecasts (they are scenarios).
Findings beyond La Liga 2015/16 (one competition, one season).
